name: Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang 2026
short_description: A full marathon of 41.76 km with 1,632 m elevation gain, held on 30 August 2026 in Gertak Sanggul, Penang, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Travis Hegel Marathon du Trans Penang 2026 is a full marathon covering 41.76 km, set to take place on 30 August 2026 in Gertak Sanggul, Penang, Malaysia. The course includes a notable elevation gain of 1,632 meters, making it a challenging route for participants. Registration is currently open for runners interested in taking part in this Malaysian marathon event.
pros: Registration is currently open, giving runners time to plan and prepare
Set in Gertak Sanggul, Penang, offering a distinctive Malaysian coastal race location
Standard full-marathon distance of 41.76 km for those training for that specific distance
Significant elevation gain of 1,632 m offers a challenging course for runners seeking a tougher test
cons: The 1,632 m elevation gain may make this course difficult for runners seeking a flat marathon
research_highlights: Course covers 41.76 km from Gertak Sanggul in the south to Tanjung Bungah in the north of Penang Island, with roughly 40% trail and 60% road terrain and about 1,632 m of elevation gain.

Route passes landmarks such as Bukit Genting, the Balik Pulau roti seller mural, and Air Itam Dam, with checkpoints at Pulau Betong (7km), Bukit Genting foothill (16km), Balik Pulau Foodcourt (23km), Air Itam Dam (30km), and Station 84/46 (37-38km).
Race starts at 5:00am with a generous 14-hour cutoff (finish by 7:00pm), intended to allow runners of varying abilities to complete the course.
This is a young event — the first edition ran in 2025, using routes previously popular with local hikers and trail runners for the south-north island traverse.
Race is 'semi-self-sufficiency': personal support crew is not allowed along the route except at official checkpoints/water stations, and trekking poles are permitted.
research_watchouts: Strict DNF policy: runners who DNF are not permitted to continue on their own and must wait at a checkpoint or safe location for a race shuttle for pickup.
No personal assistance from support crew is allowed anywhere on course except at designated checkpoints/water stations.

As a newly established race (2025 first edition), there is little independent participant feedback or race-report history available yet — one aggregator listing explicitly notes no reviews have been submitted.

Course finish location (Faizal Homestay, Tanjung Bungah) and start (Country Home and Cafe, Gertak Sanggul) are in relatively remote residential/village areas, so logistics for drop-off/pickup should be planned in advance.
